info.name: Cross_Border_Command — Zoho Books Sync (P2P + Sales)
info.description:
Every app endpoint that pushes records into Zoho Books, folder-wise, with request payloads that match the CURRENT controller validation (verified 2026-07-21), plus curl. Set collection variables `base_url` (default http://127.0.0.1:8000; prod https://cbc.idims.in) and `token` (Sanctum bearer from POST /api/login — auto-saved by the login test script). Every sync needs Zoho Books connected on the server (ZOHO_BOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN + ZOHO_BOOKS_ORG_ID in .env) else it returns 503. See ZOHO_BOOKS_FLOW.md for the end-to-end flow.

P2P mapping: PO → Zoho PO + Bill + payments · Direct SPI → Zoho Bill + payments · Debit Note → Zoho Vendor Credit. A With-PO SPI is billed through its PO (its own sync is redirected).

exec: var j; try { j = pm.response.json(); } catch(e) { return; }

request.description:
Email + password login → `{ token, user }`. Validation: email required|email, password required. The test script stores the token into {{token}} for every other request.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json' -d '{"email":"igcceo@mailinator.com","password":"Secret@123"}'

item.name: 01 · Purchase Order → Zoho PO + Bill + Payments
item.description:
WITH-PO flow lives here. Sequence: cut TDS once → record payments until the PO net-payable balance is cleared → SYNC.

SYNC creates: (1) the Zoho Purchase Order, (2) the BILL from the PO — TDS is deducted in the adjustment so the bill settles at NET PAYABLE (grand_total − TDS), (3) each Cleared payment as its own Zoho vendor payment applied to that bill (reference = 'UTR · SPI-code'). Stores zoho_purchaseorder_id + zoho_bill_id + zoho_bill_number on the PO. Idempotent: a re-sync tops up only newly-added payments (tracked per row via zoho_applied_amount). The linked SPI's own sync is redirected here → one bill per PO. (updated 2026-07-21)

request.description:
`PoPaymentController@summary`. Returns { po, supplier, amounts{ base,gstPct,gstAmount,additionalCharges,totalPo,tdsPct,tdsAmount,tdsCut,netPayable,amountPaid,balance,paidCount,progressPct }, payments[] }. Each payment row now carries `source`: { type:'po', po:{id,code}, spi:{id,code}|null } — backend trace of which PO/SPI the payment was made against.

curl:
curl -s {{base_url}}/api/p2p/purchase-orders/8/payment-summary -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -H 'Accept: application/json'

`PoPaymentController@saveTds`. Validation: `tds_percentage` required|numeric|min:0|max:100. TDS is cut on the BASE (Total PO − GST − Additional Charges = goods value). 422 'TDS is already cut' if re-cut. Must run before any payment.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/p2p/purchase-orders/8/payment-summary/tds -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tds_percentage":2}'

formdata.description: required|numeric|min:0.01 — cannot exceed the outstanding balance
nullable|in:Cleared,Pending — only Cleared payments post to Zoho
nullable|integer — which SPI this payment is for (traces the source; shown in Zoho reference as 'UTR · SPI-code')

request.description:
`PoPaymentController@store` — record ONE payment against the PO (multipart). Guards: 422 before TDS is cut · 422 if amount > outstanding balance. Stored in `po_payments` (purchase_order_id always; supplier_purchase_invoice_id optional). On sync each Cleared payment becomes its own Zoho vendor payment applied to the bill.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/p2p/purchase-orders/8/payments -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -F amount=50000.00 -F bank_name=HDFC -F utr_cheque_number=UTR0000012345 -F utr_cheque_date=2026-07-21 -F status=Cleared -F supplier_purchase_invoice_id=16 -F attachment=@/path/to/proof.pdf

`PurchaseOrderController@sync` — NO body. Creates the Zoho PO + Bill (TDS deducted → net payable) + posts each Cleared payment. GSTIN read from vendors.gst_number (fallback vendor_gst_scrutiny); registered → forward GST; intra vs inter (vendor state vs Zoho org state) → CGST+SGST vs IGST. Guards: 503 unconfigured · 409 concurrent (Cache::lock) · already-synced (zoho_purchaseorder_id + zoho_bill_id) → tops up new payments only · 422 no vendor / no items / not fully utilised (netPayable − paid > 0).

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/p2p/purchase-orders/8/sync -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -H 'Accept: application/json'

`PurchaseOrderController@zohoPdf` — stream Zoho's own rendered PO PDF (tenant-scoped cache). 404 until synced.

curl:
curl -s {{base_url}}/api/p2p/purchase-orders/8/zoho-pdf -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -o zoho-po.pdf

item.name: 02 · Supplier Invoice → Zoho Bill (Direct SPI only)
item.description:
Only DIRECT SPIs (no linked PO) sync here. A WITH-PO SPI is REDIRECTED → 422 'This invoice is under a purchase order — sync the PO to Zoho Books instead' (so there is one bill per purchase, no duplicates).

Direct-SPI flow: cut TDS + pay the SPI in full → SYNC. Sync creates the Zoho Bill from line items + taxes with TDS DEDUCTED (settles at NET PAYABLE), sets bill# AND reference# = the SPI code, posts its `spi_payments` as vendor payments (bank-matched, capped at bill balance), caches the PDF. Re-sync tops up any payment that failed. (updated 2026-07-21)

request.description:
`SpiPaymentController@summary` — Direct-SPI payment popup (base/GST/TDS/net/paid/balance + history). Each payment row carries `source`: { type:'spi', po:null, spi:{id,code} }. A With-PO SPI pays through its PO instead (folder 01).

curl:
curl -s {{base_url}}/api/p2p/supplier-purchase-invoices/7/payment-summary -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}'

`SpiPaymentController@saveTds`. Validation: `tds_percentage` required|numeric|min:0|max:100. TDS on the BASE (goods value only). 422 'already deducted' if re-cut.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/p2p/supplier-purchase-invoices/7/payment-summary/tds -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tds_percentage":5}'

formdata.description: required|numeric|min:0.01 — cannot exceed the outstanding balance

request.description:
`SpiPaymentController@store` — pay a Direct SPI (multipart). Stored in `spi_payments` (supplier_purchase_invoice_id set). 422 before TDS is cut · 422 over-balance.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/p2p/supplier-purchase-invoices/7/payments -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -F amount=11800 -F bank_name=SBI -F utr_cheque_number=UTRSPI0000001 -F utr_cheque_date=2026-07-21 -F status=Cleared

`SupplierPurchaseInvoiceController@sync` — Direct SPI only, NO body. Creates the Zoho Bill (bill# = reference# = SPI code; TDS deducted → net payable) + posts spi_payments as vendor payments. Guards: 503 · 409 · idempotent (re-sync tops up unposted payments) · 422 no vendor / no items / not fully utilised · 422 if it has a purchase_order_id → 'sync the PO instead'. GSTIN from vendors.gst_number (fallback scrutiny).

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/p2p/supplier-purchase-invoices/7/sync -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -H 'Accept: application/json'

`SupplierPurchaseInvoiceController@zohoPdf` — stream the cached Zoho Bill PDF. 404 until synced.

curl:
curl -s {{base_url}}/api/p2p/supplier-purchase-invoices/7/zoho-pdf -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -o zoho-bill.pdf

item.name: 03 · Debit Note → Zoho Vendor Credit
item.description: A debit note REDUCES the payable → maps to a Zoho Vendor Credit (NOT a bill). It MUST be fully paid (grand_total − total_paid ≤ 0) before sync — else 422 'Recover the full debit amount first — ₹X outstanding' (2026-07-21). The linked SPI must already be synced as a bill (its bill_id is sent at creation — this org enforces 'raise credit against a bill'). Sync creates the vendor credit AND applies it against the linked bill (capped at the bill's open + un-recovered balance). Re-sync retries the apply. Recovery payments are tracked locally but NOT pushed to Zoho (would be a Vendor Credit Refund — not implemented).

request.description:
`DebitNotePaymentController@summary` — recovery popup (grand_total / total_paid / balance + history).

curl:
curl -s {{base_url}}/api/p2p/debit-notes/1/payment-summary -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}'

formdata.description: required|numeric|min:0.01 — cannot exceed the outstanding (un-recovered) balance

request.description:
`DebitNotePaymentController@store` — record an amount recovered against the debit note (multipart). 422 over-recovery. Note: fields are `reference_no` + `paid_date` (NOT utr_cheque_*). Recovering the full amount is what unlocks the Zoho sync.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/p2p/debit-notes/1/payments -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -F amount=500 -F bank_name=HDFC -F reference_no=REC-1 -F paid_date=2026-07-21 -F status=Cleared

item.name: POST {id}/sync  → Zoho Vendor Credit (+ apply to bill)

request.description:
`DebitNoteController@sync` — NO body. Create a Zoho Vendor Credit (bill_id = linked SPI's bill) and apply it to that bill. Guards: 503 · 409 · idempotent (re-sync retries the apply) · 422 no vendor / no items / linked SPI not yet synced / NOT fully paid ('Recover the full debit amount first — ₹X outstanding').

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/p2p/debit-notes/1/sync -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -H 'Accept: application/json'

`DebitNoteController@zohoPdf` — stream the cached Zoho vendor-credit PDF. 404 until synced.

curl:
curl -s {{base_url}}/api/p2p/debit-notes/1/zoho-pdf -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -o zoho-vc.pdf

item.name: 04 · Quotation → Zoho Estimate
item.description: Sales side. Sync creates a Zoho Estimate from the quotation's line items (customer created once + deduped by name). Zoho auto-numbers the estimate; our QT code rides on reference_number. Forward GST always applies on a sale; inter-state IGST only for a GST-registered customer.

request.description:
`QuotationController@sync` — NO body. Guards: 503 · 409 · idempotent · 422 no customer / no items. Edit/delete blocked after sync.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/sales/quotations/13/sync -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -H 'Accept: application/json'

`QuotationController@zohoPdf` — stream the cached Zoho Estimate PDF. 404 until synced.

curl:
curl -s {{base_url}}/api/sales/quotations/13/zoho-pdf -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -o zoho-estimate.pdf

item.name: 05 · Proforma Invoice → Zoho Invoice
item.description: Sales side. Sync creates a Zoho Invoice from the PI's line items (same customer/product dedup + GST rules as the estimate). Zoho auto-numbers the invoice; our INV code rides on reference_number.

request.description:
`ProformaInvoiceController@sync` — NO body. Guards: 503 · 409 · idempotent · 422 no customer / no items. Edit/delete blocked after sync.

curl:
curl -s -X POST {{base_url}}/api/sales/proforma-invoices/10/sync -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -H 'Accept: application/json'

`ProformaInvoiceController@zohoPdf` — stream the cached Zoho Invoice PDF. 404 until synced.

curl:
curl -s {{base_url}}/api/sales/proforma-invoices/10/zoho-pdf -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -o zoho-invoice.pdf
